items.opportunity: Reclaim touches from committee mates if fully healthy.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice today due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP Wednesday.
items.implication: Monitor; could elevate JK Dobbins or other DEN RBs if sits.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB upside in DEN backfield.

items.text: With new information, 49ers and De’Zhaun Stribling opt to repair his deltoid rupture. Surgery will allow complete recovery; back late November or early December (~10 weeks).
items.why: Deltoid rupture surgery decision for full recovery.
items.implication: Longer absence opens SF WR snaps.
items.opportunity: Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson elevated roles/targets.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow told reporters he is dealing with back tightness and didn’t practice Wednesday. He got plenty of mental reps and expects to play Sunday. Status worth watching.
items.why: Back tightness led to DNP; expects to play after mental reps.
items.implication: Monitor practice reports; CIN pass game (Chase/Higgins) could be affected if limited.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 scrimmage yds, 2 TDs. Utilization Score 99 tied Bijan. Upgrades to every-down high-end RB1.
items.why: Dominant multi-phase usage in debut under new scheme/OL; historical comps average 23+ PPG.
items.implication: Lock as RB1; buy if available low.
items.opportunity: Elite snap/rush/route/target/goal-line share.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week. Top add in FFHH discussion amid SF WR injuries (Stribling longer absence).
items.why: SF WR depth chart opens with Stribling surgery; Deebo proven producer in expanded role.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for immediate WR flex/upside.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets with teammate absences.

items.text: As expected, Kenneth Walker went to KC to be a true workhorse. Handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share). 23-173-1 rush, 3-18-1 rec. He fucks.
items.why: Near-exclusive early down + receiving work in Chiefs debut confirms workhorse role.
items.implication: Elite RB1 usage; hold/start confidently ROS.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target/carry share with goal-line involvement.

items.text: First Rest Of Season Rankings show live discussing CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty, Jalen Coker and more if season started today. Pat Thorman Week 2 rankings live.
items.why: Post-Week 1 role/injury adjustments; Jeanty high after strong debut usage.
items.implication: Trade/ value adjustments; prioritize high-opportunity players like Jeanty/CMC.
items.opportunity: Jeanty every-down upside confirmed in early data.

items.text: Jake Tonges is out for the season because of an MCL tear that requires surgery. 49ers placed him on IR.
items.why: Torn MCL requiring surgery; season-ending.
items.implication: SF TE depth thins; Kittle primary, possible elevation for others.
items.opportunity: Increased role for George Kittle or fill-ins.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1. He simply played a horrific game.
items.why: High xFP (opportunity) but poor finish; regression candidate to mean.
items.implication: Don't panic sell; underlying usage supports better production ahead.
items.opportunity: Strong expected points from targets/location indicate role is there.

items.text: Rashee Rice has tiny career aDOT of 4.9 yards (2.5 last night). Needs serious volume. Only 2 targets (7% share) notable, but routes were there: 29 on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd to Worthy 30).
items.why: High routes but low aDOT and volume; efficiency/volume dependent for fantasy payoff.
items.implication: Monitor target share; routes positive but box-score risk if volume stays low.
items.opportunity: Route participation solid; volume expansion needed for WR1 upside.
